packages.name: hawking-adapters
packages.description: One model-family adapter ABI + honest support-level registry. Generates ABI/schema/CLI surface/completion/SDK types/events/Fabric/tool-effect artifacts and versioned schema migrations from the sole FamilyRegistry. No family is PRODUCTION today. Owns the sole package-contained Bridge surface authority.

packages.name: hawking-events
packages.description: Canonical Hawking/HIDE event model: one durable Event authority, deprecation adapters for superseded models, category kind registry, and export for HAWKING_CANONICAL_EVENTS.json

packages.description: Shared domain contracts for the HIDE local-first IDE architecture

packages.name: hide-protocol
packages.description: The single schema authority for the HIDE Agent Server: semantic object model + protocol (Bible sec 14, sec 15). Model-free.

packages.name: hide-serve
packages.description: Localhost HTTP + WebSocket transport exposing hide-backend::BackendHost to the HIDE web front end

packages.name: hide-backend
packages.description: Backend composition and connector facade for HIDE

packages.name: hawking-context
packages.description: Context compiler, memory, and KV abstractions for HIDE

packages.name: hawking-index
packages.description: Living codebase index API and daemon scaffold for HIDE

packages.name: hawking-orch
packages.description: Model role registry and inference orchestration scaffold for HIDE

packages.name: hawking-research
packages.description: Headless research lab, ingestion, and knowledge graph scaffold for HIDE

packages.name: hide-fleet
packages.description: Parallel agent fleet, workstation mode, and batch orchestration scaffold for HIDE

packages.name: hide-kernel
packages.description: Headless HIDE agent kernel scaffold

packages.name: hawking-eval
packages.description: Local capability evaluation: HIDE coding pass@1 + Odyssey G5 support-halo tournament judge

packages.name: hawking-perception
packages.description: HCLI Perception Service: cheap-first document pipeline interfaces and stubs (Ascension Bible §19). Model-free; OCR/vision backends are DEFERRED.

packages.name: hawking-comms
packages.description: HCLI Communication Bus: LEVEL 1 text / LEVEL 2 structured state / LEVEL 3 experimental latent sealed-packet format (Ascension Bible §20). Model-free; no live KV transfer.

packages.name: hide-gateway
packages.description: HCLI Retrieval Gateway + Tool Gateway scaffold (ascension bible §§15–16). Model-free typed contracts, ranking interfaces, tool-bundle retrieval, and tool-defect vs model-failure classification. Not wired to live indexes or MCP yet.

packages.name: hide-acp
packages.description: Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server boundary so HIDE appears as an agent inside ACP-speaking editors (Bible sec 10, sec 69). Wire shapes are spec-derived from the public Apache-2.0 ACP spec; model-free.

packages.name: q4k_fast_tool
packages.description: Offline tool to re-lay GGUF Q4_K tensors into Q4K_FAST sidecar files

packages.name: awq_bake_tool
packages.description: Offline tool to bake AWQ smoothing (W' = W * s) into Q4_K tensors and emit a Q4K_FAST-format sidecar.

packages.name: tq_bake_tool
packages.description: Offline TQ (Trellis-Quant) weight baker — GGUF -> .tq via the absorbed strand-quant encoder.
